> A 2-hour, hands-on introduction to making plots in R with `ggplot2`, using
> the Palmer Penguins dataset. For RISE 2026 summer researchers — no prior R
> needed.

## Set up your environment

Everything runs in **GitHub Codespaces** — nothing to install.

1. Go to the [participant environment repo](https://github.com/kwondry/r-tutorial-rise-2026)
   and click **"Use this template" → "Create a new repository"**.
2. On your copy: **"Code" → "Codespaces" → "Create codespace on main"**.
3. When it finishes building, open `notebooks/00-hello.qmd` and run the cell.
   A penguin chart should appear — that means you are ready.

## The dataset

We use `palmerpenguins`: measurements of 344 penguins from three species
(Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo) across three islands. Each **row** is one penguin;
each **column** is something measured about it (flipper length, body mass,
species, island, …).
